title: ProviderRunReceipt v1 (RATIFIED 2026-07-05)
$comment: STATUS: v1 — RATIFIED 2026-07-05 (operator, Option A per docs/campaigns/public-mvp/ratification-memo-work-container-v1.md). First provider: claude_code, STRUCTURALLY conformant (registered, fail-closed) with live supervised evidence via CD-4B (sess_aabb2a056f9f); RUNTIME (container-consumption) conformance not yet demonstrated — gated on S4 dispatch wiring. Schema changes from here are versioned (v1 → v2), not silent. This schema exports names for existing AG law; it does not create a new authority surface. A provider run receipt is TESTIMONY: what the provider observed it did. It is NOT an AG verdict and NEVER carries one (see ag_review). AG's admission is a separate gate_receipt. Reuses receipt_v1 execution vocabulary; introduces no parallel verdict enum. See docs/api/provider-integration.md.

work_container_ref.$comment: projects from: work_container.v1 custody.digest — the parent this run performed.

provider_status.$comment: The PROVIDER's own observable LIFECYCLE state only — NOT an AG judgment. A provider never reports 'refused'/'inadmissible' (those are AG verdicts, emitted as a gate_receipt after review). 'blocked' means the provider itself could not proceed and MUST emit a provider_obstruction. provider.completed_observed != AG.admitted; provider.success != reliance.

execution.$comment: projects from: libs/receipt_v1/schema/receipt.schema.json execution.status (reused verbatim) + receipt_kernel CmdRun (exit + digests).

outer_cage.$comment: Enforcement is the OUTER cage (AG/bwrap/docker/porter), not the provider's promise. Recorded as testimony about how the run was fenced.

declared_artifacts.$comment: projects from: ReviewPacket.ReviewArtifact — references only, no content. Declared by the provider; verified by AG.

obstruction_ref.$comment: Present when provider_status is blocked/refused; points to a provider_obstruction.v1.

ag_review.$comment: does not mint: authority. ALWAYS null in a provider receipt. AG's admission verdict is a SEPARATE gate_receipt (verdict pass|warn|block|observe|proceed, role authority), never written by the provider. Fail-closed: a provider cannot supply its own admission.
